syarat_s4_p1: Delivery time may vary depending on courier availability and destination. We are not responsible for delays caused by the shipping provider or force majeure beyond our control.
syarat_s4_p2: Shipping costs will be calculated and shown at checkout. The risk of loss transfers to you once the order is handed over to the courier.
syarat_s5_p1: We accept product returns within 7 days of receipt, provided the product is unopened, unused, and in its original packaging. Skincare products with a broken seal are not eligible for return for hygiene reasons.
syarat_s5_p2: If a product arrives defective or incorrect, please contact our customer service within 48 hours to arrange a replacement or full refund.
